Class CameraTests

java.lang.Object
renderer.CameraTests
class CameraTests extends Object
Unit tests for class Camera.

The tests verify:

  • Camera construction validity using Camera.Builder
  • Camera.constructRay(int, int)

    • baseBuilder

      private Camera.Builder baseBuilder()
      Creates a basic builder with valid location and view-plane distance.
      Returns:
      initialized camera builder

    • testBuild

      @Test void testBuild()
      Test method for Camera.Builder.

      Verifies build validity only. The test checks whether camera construction succeeds or fails with an exception, without checking geometric correctness.

    • testConstructRay

      @Test void testConstructRay()
      Test method for Camera.constructRay(int, int).

      Verifies ray construction through representative pixels in 3x3 and 4x4 view planes, including all three direction-setting overloads.
